newsitem.title: UK: UK gas deregulation means poor pay more - watchdog.
newsitem.headline: UK gas deregulation means poor pay more - watchdog.

text.p: Britain's gas consumer watchdog has warned that poorer families could face higher gas bills than wealthier customers as competition is widened to cover a further one and half million households on Monday.
The Gas Consumers Council said on Sunday that customers with credit and bank accounts who pay by direct debit can expect to gain more than poorer customers using pre-payment meters.
"We would, of course, expect there to be a range of tariff prices...but some of these gaps seem socially unacceptable," said GCC Director Sue Slipman in a statement.
